chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down in

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Teach me the inward sense of this lesson: when a person is raised into a clearer discernment of truth and from that height examines the lower understanding where truths lie in general form and are mixed with obscurities, what he then perceives about himself in that lower plane appears inverted, as though what ought to rule were serving and what ought to serve were ruling. Yet when he fixes his attention on that lower plane itself as if it were the whole of truth, his genuine quality is not disclosed there, and he cannot recognize himself from that level.

Also teach me this: the inverted appearance of human quality and of perceptive form within the lower understanding is bound up with the secret of a Divine incitement and awakening that was sent down into states of falsity to meet the good that enters directly into conflict with evil. That awakening let itself down into the lower degree as if it had wholly cast itself into it; in the same way the Divine call descended into the states beneath with power, persistence, and unwearied application.

Teach me this too: when a person lifts his interior sight away from that lower plane, he cannot then see his own quality in it, because what had been appearing belongs to the lower degree and remains below the present regard. This discloses the secret of obedience returning upward: submission and reception rising from the lower degree—from within the good that was in combat—toward the living operation of the Divine. This is a spiritual secret made known so that it may be understood.

If one wishes to grasp another outward-seeming secret on the same subject, let him consider this: the human quality, the affections of life, and the forms of perception can be seen within general external truth as though suspended and reversed. This is because the higher ordering of knowledges and their fixed patterns, when viewed from the plane of common externals, appear contrary to their own origin. Human qualities, affections, and perceptions depend upon that higher ordering and are derived from it; therefore, whenever one looks into general external truth, he perceives an image of higher causes in a reversed order, and so something of the hidden nature of their origin is disclosed by that inversion.

Nor is this the only instance: even the beginning of a new human state, when it is approaching its outward manifestation, is first arranged in a contrary orientation, and it enters the outer life by what is primary; therefore that secret too is mirrored in general external truths, where beginnings present themselves in a reversed form.

Further, this also is revealed: the mere attendant appearance that follows a person in his progress clings continually to what is lowest and cannot separate from it; and if the person is inwardly troubled and disordered, that attendant appearance becomes more dominant in the outermost life, so that he cannot act rightly there. This is a great sign that the whole outward person is from the lowest degree and has been brought up from the extreme natural level; therefore the attendant appearance remains bound to what is lowest, facing downward, as something hanging from what is higher and having no life from itself.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: The chapter holds together as a single teaching on how higher realities appear reversed when viewed within lower generals, then extends that principle to descent for rescue, ascent by obedience, and finally to the way merely external appearance clings to the lowest level and can dominate when the mind is troubled. The voice is largely consistent; the only slight stumble is the duplication of descending agencies in ¶3, which may imply two closely related Divine operations.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential opening: a natural optical phenomenon is used to teach by function (higher/lower standpoint yields inversion; fixation on the lower yields no true self-knowledge). No narrative seam or foreign administrative apparatus.
findings.evidence: Text: “when the person is above water… why… his head turned upside down… Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible.” The spiritual reading could render this as a stable functional contrast between higher discernment and lower general truth, with no forced names or jurisdictions. No stumble noted here.

findings.diagnosis: Minor mixed/unclear agency (doublet) inside an otherwise correspondential descent motif: “summons” is made to act like a person plunging headlong, but it is also positioned within a mythic administrative frame (mission “sent down… towards the First Man”). This reads like a seam where a functional image (inversion/descent) is yoked to a named-soteriological episode, producing the reader’s only noted stumble (two descending agencies / unclear distinction).
findings.evidence: Text compresses two logics: (a) correspondential function: “cast itself down… like a person… plunges headlong into water”; (b) administrative/mythic targeting: “summons… sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man.” The spiritual reading explicitly notes: “The distinction between the incitement/awakening and the Divine call is slightly unclear; both are rendered as descending Divine operations.” That confusion is explained textually as a doublet/over-determination of the descending actor: the optical-correspondential ‘plunge’ is clear, but the added named episode (“towards the First Man”) pulls it into hypostatic mission language without adding functional differentiation.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential ascent-counterpart to ¶3: the functional logic is symmetrical (lifting head from water → image disappears; ascent of obedience from below → return movement). The named figure “Living Spirit” is present but does not introduce jurisdictions or inventories; it remains narratively active as the terminus of ascent and preserves the functional teaching.
findings.evidence: Text: “Shall the person lift his head up… his face shall not be visible… This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below… to the Living Spirit.” The spiritual reading reports no rupture and could preserve function: “shifting from descent to ascent.” The name does not generate a list or administrative structure; it functions as the ‘upward pole’ of the movement.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential exemplification (cosmic and embryological) expanding the same inversion principle by functional dependence and ‘hanging’: reflection shows things “hanging upside down”; stars/zodiac “hang upside down… visible in the great sea”; the fetus “hangs upside down… born head first.” This is not administrative territory-management but analogical function (suspension/orientation/derivation).
findings.evidence: Text: “stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea… shapes inverted” + “child… hangs upside down and is born head first.” The spiritual reading admits it is doing “functional translation rather than named-cosmology retention,” but it does not report a narrative break; the teaching remains one continuous correspondential chain of examples of inversion.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty only in damaged spots, not an insertion: admonitory/moral application of the same ‘downward adhesion’ theme (shadow clings to earth; mental trouble strengthens shadow; inability to do good). The shift in tone is an internal homiletic turn, not an administrative overlay (no ranks, jurisdictions, inventories).
findings.evidence: Text: “shadow… joined to the earth… If the person is troubled… It is impossible for him to do [anything good]… great sign… body came from the earth… ascended from the abyss.” The spiritual reading notes: “tone becomes more admonitory here, but remains coherent.” The bracketed lacunae (“[becomes strong]”, “[anything good]”) account for slight roughness without improving narrative flow by removal.

textual_criticism.summary: Findings: 5 total. The chapter is overwhelmingly in the correspondential (functional) substrate and is narratively coherent. One minor mixed-voice pressure point occurs at ¶3 where a functional descent image is yoked to a named mythic targeting (“towards the First Man”), producing the reading’s only stumble (unclear duplication of descending agencies). No passage meets the criteria for excision; no block is purely administrative requiring annotation.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: instruct me about this lesson: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?

[And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce] in this way it cast itself down [to the worlds of darkness] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.

And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit. This is a spiritual mystery that I have [revea]led to you so that you would understand it.

If you wish to understand another corporeal mystery on this subject, listen and I may teach you to understand it. The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.

⟨p.255⟩
Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.

Furthermore, I reveal something else to you: Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [in his mind] his shadow up upon the earth [becomes strong] above. It is impossible for him to do [anything good] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.

changes_summary: No changes made. The critic’s findings (Summary; Findings 1–5) explicitly recommend “none” throughout and state that no passage meets criteria for excision; therefore the restored chapter text is retained unchanged.
